svg.title: Flight helmet retirement plaque - assembled preview and glue-up guide
svg.text: Flight helmet retirement plaque - layered 3 mm basswood
Finished size 216 x 236 mm (8.5 x 9.3 in), 5 layers deep (15 mm) plus easel stand
Glue each layer with thin wood glue; clamp
flat between steps. Pieces on the same
layer butt together like a jigsaw.
(cross-lap), glue the leg tab into the slot
in the back of part 1. Leans back 15 deg.
Step 2 - dark rim on the back plate
Step 3 - shell face, mask, strap, hose
Step 4 - visor base, edge roll, hardware
Step 5 - visor cover and valve cap
